name: Goblin
description: Small, quick, and clever, goblins survived the Dark Lord’s fall by knowing which ruins to pick over and which to leave alone.

name: Orc
description: Bred for the Dark Lord’s wars and left with no war to fight, orcs hold the wastes by strength and stubbornness, and talk their way out of very little.

name: Elf
description: The last elves are graceful, persuasive, and slight, drifting through a land that remembers them as strangers who stayed out of the war until it was too late.

name: Centaur
description: Centaurs carry the strength of their beast halves and range the open wastes in lineages named for the animals they resemble.

lineages.name: Deer
lineages.description: Light, fleet centaurs who outrun trouble rather than meet it.

lineages.name: Lion
lineages.description: Powerful hunters, quick to pounce and slow to think twice.

lineages.name: Bison
lineages.description: Massive and enduring, but slow to turn.

name: Beastman
description: Flesh-crafted soldiers born of animal mothers, a year from birth to the battle line. Every free beastman is a deserter from some army, and their source animal shapes what they are.

lineages.name: Herd
lineages.description: Goat, sheep, or cattle stock: the common kind, horned, bred for loyalty.

lineages.name: Pack
lineages.description: Dog or wolf stock: less common, quick to move as one.

lineages.name: Predator
lineages.description: Big-cat or bear stock: rare, made to be set loose behind enemy lines, with an infiltrator's or a feral past.

name: Gnome
description: Small, wise, and endlessly curious, gnomes kept their workshops and libraries hidden through the war and are only now opening the doors.
